messages:
Maya (CS): Hey team — prepping the leadership briefing for Atlas Labs next Tue. Need a tight deck (8-10 slides), one-page ask list, and a final action queue. Main asks: adoption metrics, onboarding open issues, renewal risk table, enablement schedule, and 3 exec talking points.
Jared (CSE): On it. I'll pull week-over-week adoption and top 5 feature usage. ETA: EOD today.
Priya (AM): I'll surface stakeholder sentiment + renewal health flags. Quick question — do we want the risk table to use the 3-tier rubric (Green/Yellow/Red) or a score?
Maya (CS): 3-tier is fine for execs. Add a numeric score column for our internal notes.
Samir (PM): Recommendation: show 2 slides — 1) health snapshot with 3-tier and 2) root-cause bullets for any Yellow/Red. Keep language causal not technical.
Alex R: I grabbed the new slide template from the leadership kit: https://drive.redwood/internals/leadership-kit (use the 2-column layout). I'll start a branch in Drive and paste the outline.
Jared (CSE): Sharing a quick chart I'm planning: `Weekly active seats | MAU | Feature adoption % (week over week)` — will include a small sparkline for the last 12 weeks.
Priya (AM): For renewal flags, I'll include: contract end date, CSM sentiment note, NPS snippet, and recent support tickets > 2. Will tag the risky ones.
Maya (CS): Example slide bullet for execs (short):
```
- Current status: Adoption +12% QoQ, onboarding velocity improving
- Risk: Renewal at-risk due to integration delays (Stakeholder X)
- Ask: Exec alignment to prioritize partner integration (2-week task)
```
Samir (PM): Also propose an enablement slide with clear owner + ETA per item: `Onboarding playbook update — Jared — Wed`, `Customer workshop — Priya — next Thu`, `API docs refresh — Eng Docs — 2w`.
Alex R: I added a placeholder slide for the exec asks and a timeline graphic. Link to draft: https://drive.redwood/atlas-briefing/draft (comment on anything you want changed).
Jared (CSE): Pushed numbers to the draft (sheet tab: adoption-metrics). Note: there is a 7-day delay in instrumentation for a specific event; flagged in the sheet.
eng-bot: Reminder: please ensure any customer examples are scrubbed of PII before publishing.
Priya (AM): Quick check — are we including customer quotes? I have one short one from the CISO that summarizes value.
Maya (CS): Yes include 1 short quote on slide 2. Priya, paste it into the draft and mark source.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Atlas Labs — Leadership Briefing" Tue 10:00–10:45 (Invited: execs, CSMs).
Maya (CS): Action list (assignments):
- Jared: finalize adoption charts + confirm instrumentation caveat (due: EOD today)
- Priya: push renewal risk table + one quote (due: tomorrow noon)
- Alex R: finish visuals + slide order (due: tomorrow 5pm)
- Samir: write 2-3 root-cause bullets for any Yellow/Red accounts (due: tomorrow 3pm)
- Maya: compile one-page asks & rehearse dry run (due: day before)

Please react with :white_check_mark: when your item is done. I'll run a 20-min dry run on Mon 4pm.
Jared (CSE): ✅ I'll mark when numbers final.
Priya (AM): ✅ Adding quote now.
Alex R: ✅ Will finish visuals by 5pm.
Samir (PM): ✅ Will add root-cause bullets by 3pm.
Maya (CS): Thanks — tagging @execs for visibility after the dry run. If anything blocks you ping me here or DM.
Jared (CSE): FYI — found one anomalous spike in event logging. I'm dropping a brief note in the sheet with recommended correction.
Priya (AM): Noted. If the spike moves anything to Yellow I'll flag in the risk table.
Maya (CS): Final note: keep language outcome-focused (revenue retention, time-to-value). Avoid deep product jargon on the exec slides. We'll iterate in the dry run.
Maya (CS): End of thread — final deck link: https://drive.redwood/atlas-briefing/final (will update after dry run).
